title: Italy Walks a Fiscal Tightrope as Industrial Weakness Clouds Modest Recovery · 25 Aug
keywords: Italy economy, Italian budget, fiscal policy, public debt, industrial output, inflation, eurozone, ECB, EU fiscal rules, Giorgia Meloni, bank levy, energy security, defence spending, GDP growth, Italian manufacturing
notes: Italy's government is seeking budgetary flexibility within EU rules to fund energy security and defence priorities, even as public debt sits at record levels and critics warn of short-term political fixes over structural reform. Meanwhile, the country's economic recovery remains uneven: services are holding up, but industrial output fell in June and inflation, though easing, continues to weigh on household budgets. The combination of fiscal pressure and fragile growth puts Rome under scrutiny both at home and in Brussels ahead of the next budget cycle.
